text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An international terrorist believed to be responsible for the Paris Metro attack is arrested in Cyprus.
- Parliament seeks a ban on bets on Cyprus games.
- Russian clears 170,000 pounds from another Russian's account and skips the island.
- Man 'linked to Paris metro bomb' held in Limassol.
- Cross-party support ensures passage of bill doing away with by-elections.
- German tourists are held for almost five hours by the Turks.
- House hears call to ban local soccer bets in wake of match-rigging charge.
- Communist Akel proposal to do away with by-elections is ratified by parliament.
- Government's refusal to take a position on cost of living allowances encourages employers not to pay it.
- Foreign mediators on the Cyprus problem throw their weight behind efforts to defuse tension in the coming months.
- Takis Kyriakides is appointed new chairman of Cyprus Airways
- Constitutional amendment rendering by-elections unnecessary will be contested by the New Horizons party at the Supreme Court.
- Eight people on board cargo vessel which capsized in the Aegean drowned.
